description: A renderer's own request, as a package's renderer of tables, mypkg's labelled_table, on another board asks for the labels of an ADaM table's columns, which a table output does not carry. It names the renderer, whose own request it is, by the package of its module and its name, so that R finds its function among the requests of the renderer that draws the output, which has to be the one named, here because the app names labelled_table for table outputs. R runs it as it runs a request of the output class, with the result the output was made from and the board option values and parameters that output was asked with.
